author: gpt-5.6-luna
brief: Phase: code review. Role of the person asking: frontend. Repo kind: a no-build browser front end for a library catalogue: plain ES modules, a tiny view helper, a fetch wrapper, CSS, an index.html, and tests with node:test that exercise pure functions and a minimal fake DOM written in the repo. The PR adds a search-as-you-type box with a suggestion list. Plant: suggestions are inserted with innerHTML from the server's titles, which can hold markup; there is no debounce, so every key press sends a request, against the API rate note in docs; a slow earlier response can overwrite a newer one; the list has no accessible name, roles or announcement, and arrow keys do not move through options; the keydown listener on document is added on every open and never removed; the empty-query case still fires a request. Add one decoy.
